delivery.outcome: Implement read-only GET /api/voice-digest endpoint in FastAPI server producing a bounded natural-language sprint summary suitable for TTS, with explicit sprint selection, status/counts aggregation, empty-sprint handling, and comprehensive API tests.
nonGoals: No microphone STT or audio playback integration in this endpoint

architecture.decision: Expose GET /api/voice-digest on the FastAPI server accepting sprint query parameter (defaulting to 'current'); query tickets using Planfile store, compute total, done, in-progress, blocked, and pending counts, and synthesize a concise, structured TTS-ready digest string along with structured metric fields; handle empty sprint gracefully.

validation.evidence: All voice digest API tests pass and governance check exits 0
